_help: PC TidyUp rules. Paths are globs, case-insensitive, with '/' separators: '*' = within one folder, '**' = any depth, {a,b} = alternatives.
action: safe (regenerable) | likely (probably obsolete) | review (your decision) | info (managed by Windows/app; shown with advice only).
dir_rules  mode: whole = the folder as one item; children = each entry inside it, filtered by min_age_days (age = newest file inside).
system: true lets the rule match inside 'protected' areas such as C:\Windows. ps: PowerShell command the cleanup script runs instead of deleting.
file_rules match by extension (exts) or file-name glob (names), optionally limited by path; age_basis: used (last access/modification) | modified.
The first matching file rule wins; files inside a folder matched by a dir_rule are not checked again.

dir_rules.label: Recycle Bin
dir_rules.reason: Deleted files still occupy the disk until the bin is emptied. Emptying it is final - check that nothing in it is still needed.
dir_rules.how: Open the Recycle Bin, restore anything you still need, then empty it.

dir_rules.label: User temp folder
dir_rules.reason: Leftovers of installers, updaters and apps; entries untouched for a week are rarely still in use. Anything in use is skipped.
dir_rules.how: Settings > System > Storage > Temporary files, or delete the old entries.

dir_rules.label: Personal temp folder
dir_rules.reason: Ad-hoc scratch folder; entries untouched for 2+ months are rarely needed.
dir_rules.how: Skim the list, delete what you no longer need.

dir_rules.label: Windows temp folder
dir_rules.reason: System-wide temporary files.
dir_rules.how: Settings > System > Storage > Temporary files (elevated).

dir_rules.label: Windows Update download cache
dir_rules.reason: Update payloads. Deleting them while an update is pending can break that update, so let Windows clean them.
dir_rules.how: Disk Cleanup (cleanmgr) > Clean up system files > Windows Update Cleanup.

dir_rules.label: Delivery Optimization cache
dir_rules.reason: Peer-to-peer update cache.
dir_rules.how: Settings > Storage > Temporary files > Delivery Optimization Files.

dir_rules.label: Previous Windows installation
dir_rules.reason: Only needed to roll back a feature update.
dir_rules.how: Settings > Storage > Temporary files > Previous Windows installation(s).

dir_rules.label: Windows Error Reporting archives
dir_rules.reason: Crash reports already sent (or never to be sent).
dir_rules.how: Disk Cleanup > Windows error reports.

dir_rules.label: Application crash dumps
dir_rules.reason: Memory dumps from crashes; useful only while troubleshooting that crash.
dir_rules.how: Delete unless you are investigating a crash.

dir_rules.label: Browser cache
dir_rules.reason: Web cache, rebuilt automatically. Skipped while the browser is running.
dir_rules.how: Browser settings > Clear browsing data > Cached images and files (close the browser first).

dir_rules.label: Web app offline storage (Service Workers)
dir_rules.reason: Offline copies kept by web apps (mail, chat, office apps). Usually re-downloaded, but some web apps keep offline data here.
dir_rules.how: Close the browser/app first. Skip it if you rely on a web app offline.

dir_rules.label: WebView2 app cache (new Teams, new Outlook, ...)
dir_rules.reason: Embedded browser cache of desktop apps, rebuilt automatically. Skipped while the app is running.
dir_rules.how: Quit the app, then delete.

dir_rules.label: Desktop app cache (Electron)
dir_rules.reason: Cache of VS Code, Postman, Slack and similar apps; rebuilt automatically. Skipped while the app is running.
dir_rules.how: Quit the app, then delete.

dir_rules.label: Classic Teams leftovers
dir_rules.reason: Classic Teams was retired in 2024; new Teams stores its data elsewhere.
dir_rules.how: Delete if you only use new Teams.

dir_rules.label: Internet / thumbnail / shader caches
dir_rules.reason: Caches rebuilt on demand.
dir_rules.how: Disk Cleanup > Temporary Internet Files / DirectX Shader Cache, or delete.

dir_rules.label: Office upload cache
dir_rules.reason: Local copies of cloud Office documents; may hold unsynced edits.
dir_rules.how: Office > File > Options > Save > Delete cached files (never delete by hand).

dir_rules.label: npm cache
dir_rules.reason: Downloaded packages, re-fetched when needed.
dir_rules.how: npm cache clean --force

dir_rules.label: pip cache
dir_rules.reason: Downloaded Python wheels.
dir_rules.how: pip cache purge

dir_rules.label: uv cache
dir_rules.reason: Downloaded Python packages.
dir_rules.how: uv cache clean

dir_rules.label: yarn / pnpm store
dir_rules.reason: Package store, re-fetched when needed.
dir_rules.how: yarn cache clean / pnpm store prune

dir_rules.label: NuGet HTTP/plugin cache
dir_rules.reason: Download cache.
dir_rules.how: dotnet nuget locals http-cache --clear

dir_rules.label: NuGet global packages
dir_rules.reason: All package versions ever restored; restored again on the next build.
dir_rules.how: dotnet nuget locals global-packages --clear

dir_rules.label: Scoop download cache
dir_rules.reason: Installer downloads of already-installed apps.
dir_rules.how: scoop cache rm *

dir_rules.label: Chocolatey backups and cache
dir_rules.reason: Failed and backup package copies (used to roll back a failed upgrade) and downloads.
dir_rules.how: choco-cleaner, or delete (elevated).

dir_rules.label: Gradle / Maven caches
dir_rules.reason: Dependency caches, re-downloaded on build.
dir_rules.how: Delete when no Java project is active.

dir_rules.label: Local AI models
dir_rules.reason: Downloaded model weights are often several GB each.
dir_rules.how: ollama list / ollama rm <model>; huggingface-cli delete-cache; remove models you no longer use.

dir_rules.label: Visual Studio caches
dir_rules.reason: MEF/designer caches, rebuilt when VS starts.
dir_rules.how: Close Visual Studio, then delete.

dir_rules.label: Visual Studio installer package cache
dir_rules.reason: Needed for repair/modify without download.
dir_rules.how: VS Installer > More > Settings > untick 'Keep download cache after the installation'.

dir_rules.label: VS Code logs & old workspace storage
dir_rules.reason: Per-session diagnostic logs.
dir_rules.how: Delete old sessions.

dir_rules.label: VS Code storage of old workspaces
dir_rules.reason: State of workspaces not opened for 6+ months (Copilot index, extension data).
dir_rules.how: Delete entries of workspaces you no longer open.

dir_rules.label: node_modules of inactive project
dir_rules.reason: Restored with 'npm install' when you work on the project again.
dir_rules.how: Delete; run npm install when needed.

dir_rules.label: Build output of inactive project
dir_rules.reason: Recreated by the next build.
dir_rules.how: Delete, or 'dotnet clean' / 'git clean -xdf' in the repo.

dir_rules.label: .vs folder of inactive solution
dir_rules.reason: Visual Studio IntelliSense DB and caches, rebuilt on open.
dir_rules.how: Delete.

dir_rules.label: Python caches
dir_rules.reason: Bytecode / tool caches, regenerated automatically.
dir_rules.how: Delete.

dir_rules.label: Python virtual env of inactive project
dir_rules.reason: Recreatable from requirements files.
dir_rules.how: Delete if the project has requirements.txt / pyproject.toml.

dir_rules.label: OneDrive / Office logs
dir_rules.reason: Diagnostic logs.
dir_rules.how: Delete old ones.

dir_rules.label: OneDrive cloud temp
dir_rules.reason: Temporary staging area used by OneDrive.
dir_rules.how: Delete old entries while OneDrive is paused.

dir_rules.label: Old application logs
dir_rules.reason: Log folders of apps; entries older than a month are seldom needed.
dir_rules.how: Delete old entries.

dir_rules.label: D365 F&O dev platform versions (UDE)
dir_rules.reason: Each downloaded F&O platform version (PackagesLocalDirectory, XRef DB backup, zip) takes several GB.
dir_rules.how: Keep the version your environments run on; delete older version folders. Inside the current one, the .zip and DYNAMICSXREFDB.bak are only needed to re-deploy.

dir_rules.label: Chrome on-device AI model
dir_rules.reason: Gemini Nano / Phi weights for browser AI features (~4 GB).
dir_rules.how: If you don't use the browser's built-in AI: disable chrome://flags/#optimization-guide-on-device-model (else it is downloaded again), then delete.

dir_rules.label: OneNote local backups
dir_rules.reason: Automatic backups of cloud notebooks that are already stored in OneDrive/SharePoint.
dir_rules.how: OneNote > File > Options > Save & Backup to change; delete old backups.

dir_rules.label: App download caches
dir_rules.reason: Copies of downloaded images/installers.
dir_rules.how: Delete.

dir_rules.label: WSL / Docker virtual disks
dir_rules.reason: Virtual disks grow but never shrink by themselves.
dir_rules.how: docker system prune -a; wsl --shutdown; then compact the .vhdx (Optimize-VHD -Mode Full, or diskpart > select vdisk > compact vdisk).

dir_rules.label: Outlook offline mailbox (OST)
dir_rules.reason: Offline copy of the mailbox.
dir_rules.how: Account settings > 'Download email for the past' = 3-12 months to shrink it.

dir_rules.label: Windows component store
dir_rules.reason: Hard links make it look bigger than it is.
dir_rules.how: Elevated: DISM /Online /Cleanup-Image /StartComponentCleanup

dir_rules.label: Windows Installer cache
dir_rules.reason: Needed to repair/uninstall installed software.
dir_rules.how: Never delete by hand; uninstall unused apps instead.

dir_rules.label: Windows logs
dir_rules.reason: Setup and servicing logs.
dir_rules.how: Disk Cleanup > Clean up system files > Windows upgrade log files / setup log files.

dir_rules.label: Windows Search index
dir_rules.reason: Can grow large with many indexed files.
dir_rules.how: Settings > Privacy & security > Searching Windows > Advanced indexing options > Rebuild / exclude folders.

dir_rules.label: Driver / vendor setup leftovers
dir_rules.reason: Extracted driver installers from OEM setup.
dir_rules.how: Delete if drivers are installed and working.

file_rules.label: Temporary / lock files
file_rules.reason: Left behind by Office and other apps after a crash or close.

file_rules.label: Hibernation / page / swap file
file_rules.how: hiberfil.sys: 'powercfg /h /type reduced' (keeps Fast Startup) or 'powercfg /h off' (elevated). Do not delete by hand.

file_rules.label: Kernel memory dump
file_rules.reason: Dump of the last blue screen.
file_rules.how: Disk Cleanup > System error memory dump files.

file_rules.label: Old log files
file_rules.reason: Log not written for 30+ days - the run it describes is over.
file_rules.how: Delete (or zip if you must keep an audit trail).

file_rules.label: Memory dumps
file_rules.reason: Crash/heap dumps; only useful during an investigation.

file_rules.label: Old installers in Downloads
file_rules.reason: Software is installed already and can be downloaded again.

file_rules.label: Old archives in Downloads
file_rules.reason: Downloaded archives are usually extracted already.
file_rules.how: Delete if the content exists elsewhere.

file_rules.label: D365 UDE setup artefacts
file_rules.reason: Download artefacts kept after the metadata was extracted and the XRef DB restored.
file_rules.how: Delete if this version is configured and builds fine; Power Platform Tools downloads it again when needed.

file_rules.label: Backup / old copies
file_rules.reason: Manual or tool-made backups that were never cleaned up.
file_rules.how: Keep only if the original no longer exists.
